description: SIH26236 Prototype Golden Evaluation Cases. Explicitly documented test fixtures representing the 8 core evaluation scenarios across dry goods, respiring produce, frozen items, acid preservation, and boundary edge cases.

cases.description: Ambient crispy snack with low water activity (aw=0.20) and high lipid content (fat=34%). Moisture sorption causes texture loss; oxygen causes oxidative rancidity.
assumptions: [PROTOTYPE ASSUMPTION] Linear permeance scaling for steady-state moisture flux.
[PROTOTYPE HEURISTIC] High lipid fraction (>20%) benchmark requires OTR <= 2.0 cm3/(m2*day*atm) and optical opacity.

cases.description: Moderate moisture (aw=0.45), high-oil commodity (fat=49%) prone to lipid peroxidation and free-radical rancidity.
assumptions: [PROTOTYPE HEURISTIC] Moderate aw (0.45) permits WVTR <= 4.5 g/(m2*day); high fat content strictly mandates OTR <= 2.0 cm3/(m2*day*atm).

cases.description: High-respiration chilled fresh produce (60 mg CO2/(kg*h) at 4 C). Requires active respiratory gas exchange; dense barrier films induce rapid anaerobic fermentation.
assumptions: [EXTERNAL EVIDENCE: Fonseca 2002] Respiration temperature adjustment follows Q10 Arrhenius scaling.
[EVIDENCE-DERIVED HEURISTIC: Kader 2002] Continuous films with OTR < 20% of equilibrium demand trigger hypoxia rejection.

cases.description: Deep-frozen vegetable stored at -18 C. Non-respiring in frozen state; primary threats are sublimation (freezer burn) and packaging embrittlement.
assumptions: [PROTOTYPE HEURISTIC: Robertson 2012] Moderate moisture barrier (WVTR <= 18.0) suppresses ice sublimation.
[QUALITATIVE CONCERN] Rigid bio-polyesters exhibit brittle impact fracture under sub-zero handling unless modified.

cases.description: High-acid commodity (pH=4.1 < 4.6). Pathogenic vegetative bacteria inhibited by natural acidity; primary deterioration pathway is carotenoid (lycopene) bleaching and mold.
assumptions: [PROTOTYPE HEURISTIC: Robertson 2012] High-acid food (pH < 4.6) targets OTR <= 60.0 cm3/(m2*day*atm) to mitigate lycopene fading.

cases.description: Active respiring crop lacking verified postharvest MAP headspace gas composition in published compendiums.
assumptions: [PROTOTYPE BOUNDARY] System refuses to hallucinate equilibrium gas concentrations when empirical data is absent from knowledge base.

cases.description: Simulation where available candidate packaging materials fail mandatory ASTM barrier limits.
assumptions: [PROTOTYPE BOUNDARY] Transparent reporting of zero eligible candidates without fabricating fallback materials.

cases.description: Evaluation of boundary input validation: physical contradiction between storage regime ('frozen') and storage temperature (+25 C).
assumptions: [PHYSICAL SANITY BOUND] Frozen storage regime is physically invalid at temperatures above 0 C.
